system.name: Courtside TW T082 coding and release-control workflow
system.purpose: Create and verify a forward-only application deployment and rollback contract without executing production actions.
users: Courtside TW maintainers and release operators
affected_parties: Courtside TW readers, editors and operators
external_services: OCI registry at future production release
identities: production migration and traffic-switch identities not provided to the Agent

data_flows.source: GitHub issues, repository and task ledger
data_flows.authorization_point: repository and task read-back before mutation

data_flows.source: isolated release manifests and readiness fixtures
data_flows.authorization_point: strict JSON schema and immutable digest validation
data_flows.retention: temporary fixtures; redacted receipt retained 14 days in CI

data_flows.purpose: independent exact-head CI, Security and review
data_flows.authorization_point: explicit T082 user direction plus protected-branch rules

unknowns: final OCI runtime images and vulnerability/SBOM receipts
T083 production monitoring and alert route

controls.implementation: Versioned T082 System Card and scope graph
controls.failure_condition: deployed scope, identity or environment differs from the inventory

controls.implementation: Production, contract migration and protected merge are separate human gates
controls.failure_condition: the Agent can approve or execute its own protected action

controls.implementation: No secret fields in manifests; production identities remain outside the controller
controls.failure_condition: a secret sentinel appears in a retained receipt or artifact

controls.implementation: Strict redacted machine receipts with bounded identifiers and no runtime URL
controls.failure_condition: receipt contains a credential, private URL, participant data or content body

controls.implementation: T082-only file allowlist and explicit production/T083+ prohibitions
controls.failure_condition: changed-file scope includes T083+, Web3, participant research or production credentials

controls.implementation: Exact production confirmation plus a separate provider traffic-switch approval
controls.failure_condition: a production mutation runs with no current exact-target approval

controls.implementation: Serialized atomic release state, immutable registration and idempotent no-op
controls.failure_condition: retry changes active release twice or leaves an unverifiable partial state

controls.implementation: Fail-closed readiness, compatibility, mutable-image and production gates
controls.failure_condition: a failed, degraded or incompatible candidate replaces the healthy active release

controls.implementation: Source SHA, OCI digest and explicit runtime-image build arguments
controls.failure_condition: runtime or release image is mutable, unscanned or lacks provenance

controls.implementation: Atomic redacted action receipts and append-only task evidence
controls.failure_condition: an action cannot be reconstructed from state, receipt and exact source head

controls.implementation: Application rollback preserves forward schema; T081 restore remains separate
controls.failure_condition: application rollback issues a destructive schema action or moves schema backward

human_gates.condition: Approve exact production environment, manifest, traffic switch, monitoring and rollback preview
Approve a later contract migration after the rollback window closes
Accept final exact-head CI, Security, artifact, review-thread and mergeability evidence

monitoring.alert_route: Production monitoring remains T083; production activation stays HOLD

rollback.method: Atomically route to a registered compatible prior application while preserving the forward database schema
